name: md-prompt
description: Paints Markdown onto Claude Code's prompt box as you type: fenced code becomes a syntax-highlighted card (even before you close the fence), and inline code, bold, italic, lists, task lists, quotes, tables, links and headings are styled. Paint only, your text is never changed. Fork of nogu66/md-prompt that adds VBA: ```vba highlighting, and Sub … End Sub typed without a fence painted as VBA, and your sent messages that hold code drawn again as Markdown with highlighted code.

mode.title: Markdown painting
mode.description: on: paint everything. code: paint only fenced code and inline code. off: leave the prompt box as plain text. /md-prompt on|code|off changes it too.

vba.title: VBA detection
vba.description: on: a VBA procedure typed without a fence (Sub … End Sub, Function … End Function, Property … End Property) is painted as VBA once its End line is typed. off: only a ```vba fence is. /md-prompt vba on|off changes it too.

history.title: Markdown in history
history.description: on: your sent messages that hold a code block (or, with VBA detection on, an unfenced VBA procedure) are drawn again in the transcript: prose as Markdown, code coloured by this plugin's own highlighter (the same colours as the prompt box, whatever syntaxHighlightingDisabled says). Only the drawing changes. off: Claude Code draws them. /md-prompt history on|off changes it too.
